name: User feedback
description: What people say about your product and your rivals, filed under the feature it is about: sentences about the product found in each member's own mail and meetings (private until they share them), public posts from Hacker News and, through the team's own Bright Data key, YouTube, X, Reddit, TikTok and LinkedIn, each filed under one of the team's features with its kind and how much it matters. One inbox to keep, move or set aside each quote; a page per feature with every quote by company; and a weekly view of what is rising. A kept request from a named person becomes an ask, so whoever tells askers tells them when it ships. Brings People map, Mail and Meetings with it.

feedback_slug.description: Public URL slug for the Feedback app (unique platform-wide; a suffix is added on collision)
